Title: Ayaan's Day

Cast

1. Ayaan - 10 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Shalini - 37 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Kunal - 8 years, friend
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ayaan stands in the courtyard. Shalini stands near him.]

Ayaan: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Ayaan jumps with joy.]

Ayaan (surprised): "Yes, all right."

[Ayaan peeks out from behind the door.]

Ayaan (softly): "What next?"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Ayaan stands in the living room. Shalini and Kunal stand near him.]

Shalini: "Let's begin."

[Ayaan studies for his exam.]

Kunal (excited): "Okay, Ayaan."

[Ayaan watches cartoons on TV.]

Shalini: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Ayaan flops down on the sofa.]

Shalini: "Yes, of course."

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Thick fog lies all around. Ayaan stands in the courtyard. Shalini stands near him.]

Ayaan: "So, here we are!"

[The mist slowly clears.]

Ayaan (excited): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
